jobs:
  x:
    steps:
      - run: rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/cache" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: rm -rf ui/node_modules
      - run: go clean -cache # want:go-clean-cache
      - run: |
          scratch="$(mktemp -d)"
          rm -rf "$scratch"
  windows:
    steps:
      - shell: pwsh
        run: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $env:GOCACHE # want:env-path-delete
      - shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $cache = go env GOMODCACHE
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $cache # want:env-path-delete
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\build
  expressions:
    steps:
      - run: rm -rf "${{ env.CACHE_ROOT }}" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: rm -rf ${{ vars.SHARED_DIR }}/build # want:env-path-delete
      - run: rm -rf "${{ env['CACHE_ROOT'] }}" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: rm -rf "${{runner.temp}}/cache" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: rm -rf "${{ inputs.cache || vars.CACHE_ROOT }}" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: rm -rf ${{ inputs.cache || 'build' }}; echo done # want:env-path-delete
      - run: |
          root="${{ env.CACHE_ROOT }}"
          rm -rf "$root" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: go clean -modcache=true # want:go-clean-cache
      - shell: pwsh
        run: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "${{ env.CACHE_ROOT }}" # want:env-path-delete
      - shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $root = "${{ vars.SHARED_DIR }}"
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $root # want:env-path-delete
  expressions-good:
    steps:
      - run: echo "${{ env.CACHE_ROOT }}"
      - run: rm -f "${{ env.CACHE_ROOT }}/lock"
      - run: echo "${{ inputs.cache || 'none' }}" && rm -rf ./build
      - run: go clean -modcache=false
      - run: |
          scratch="$(mktemp -d "${{ runner.temp }}/x.XXXXXX")"
          rm -rf "$scratch"
